item.description:
Thimble 0.9.0 brings a project's docs, pictures, and questions to iPhone, iPad, and Android, and adds Show in Finder on the Mac.
- iPhone, iPad, and Android show a project's tabs: its Overview, Roadmap, Docs read as pages, Pictures, and Questions. - Answer Claude's questions on your phone, and the Mac sees the answer. - Write and edit docs on your phone: tap to edit, Done to read again. Pin a doc to the Overview from its menu. - Add pictures from the camera or your photo library. Each is kept small and syncs to your other devices. - Show in Finder on the Mac: right-click a project to see its repo folder, a doc from the repo to see its file, or a picture to see a copy named for its caption. - `thimble areas add`, `areas move`, and `projects area` arrange the sidebar from the command line and the MCP server.
